- Build machinery (build-grammars.mjs) and testing utilities (update-pack-goldens.mjs) are isolated, cleanly separating development-time from runtime concerns
- Zero coupling to other packs enables independent language pack loading without a shared dependency chain
- Zone "lang-runtime" has files across 5 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory
- "packages/lang-runtime/scripts/build-grammars.mjs" is production code imported only by tests (5 importer(s), all test files) — either it is dead or its real caller is missing
- pack-entry.ts exists in both lang-runtime/src and lang-kit/src, so the pack entry contract has two same-named modules on two tiers; readers cannot tell from the name which one is canonical
- lang-runtime/scripts/update-pack-goldens.mjs (22 lines) and sourcevision/scripts/update-pack-goldens.mjs (31 lines) are two golden-refresh scripts with the same name for the same pack fixtures
- There are two update-pack-goldens.mjs scripts, one in lang-runtime/scripts and one in sourcevision/scripts, and both regenerate pack golden outputs. If they drift apart, goldens refreshed from one package will fail tests that use the other script's output. Keep one canonical script and remove or delegate the other.
- pack-entry.ts is defined in both packages/lang-runtime/src and packages/lang-kit/src, so the foundation contract and the runtime loader expose same-named modules. Rename one (for example pack-loader.ts in runtime) or have runtime re-export the lang-kit contract, so a pack author cannot import the wrong one.
- src/ holds three files classified as entrypoints (index.ts, pack.ts, pack-entry.ts) in a 13-file zone. The public surface of the runtime loader is spread over three modules rather than one barrel.
- Every runtime source file has a 'pack-' prefix (pack-calls.ts, pack-facts.ts, pack-package.ts, pack-entry.ts, pack.ts). Inside a package that exists only to serve packs, the prefix tells files apart from nothing, and it makes them look like the lang-kit contract files of the same names.
- Make src/index.ts the only public entry. Have it re-export what packs consume from pack.ts and pack-entry.ts, and point package.json exports at index.ts alone. Before: three entry modules. After: one barrel plus internal modules. The 10-entry-point count drops, and pack authors get a single import path.
